title: NodeListenerConfig
description: Non-secret v2 application listener projection. ParseNodeListenerConfig additionally enforces a valid canonical netip.AddrPort literal, exact-case unique JSON fields and a single JSON object. MarshalNodeListenerConfig defines digest bytes in declared field order followed by one LF; independent JSON serialization is not a digest authority.

bind_address.description: Literal IPv4 or bracketed lowercase IPv6 followed by port 1024..65535. This schema bounds the lexical shape; ParseNodeListenerConfig is also required to validate IPv6 syntax and canonical spelling. Host names, zones, leading-zero ports and whitespace are not accepted. Loopback and unspecified bind addresses are allowed.
